rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a transferable expanded blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single image, but it is somewhat generic and includes uncertain statements about zona thinning/ICM clarity without clearly tying morphology to the provided 3BA grade.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior cycle, male factor, BMI, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle reasonably well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat speculative.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimates generally matching the stated pros and cons; minor issues include overemphasis on borderline sperm motility and lining thickness.

Recommendations are mostly consistent with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and consideration of uterine/sperm evaluation after failure; slight deviations include some overstatement around endometrial thickness thresholds and PGT-A framing.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal/timing review, lifestyle advice, and further workup after failure, though some suggestions remain broad rather than protocol-specific.
